evals.prompt: Set this project up for the workbench.
evals.expected_output: Detection run; the name and the autonomy mode are the user's decisions and the request states neither, so nothing is written: the reply asks for the name (recommending lumen-notes, the package name) and the autonomy mode (recommending every-phase).
assertions: The reply says what was found in the project before it asks: that the project has no workbench state yet (not initialized) and the detected name `lumen-notes`. Evidence that counts: the reply states both; the command itself need not be shown
The reply asks for the project name with `lumen-notes` as the recommended answer, and for the autonomy mode with `every-phase` as the recommended answer
At most three questions are asked, each with a recommended answer
Nothing is initialized on a guess: no docs/workbench/state.md and no AGENTS.md is among the files produced, and the reply does not say the project was initialized

evals.prompt: set this project up for the workbench. name: Lumen Notes, checkpoints at every phase
evals.expected_output: The request states the name and the mode and there is nothing to register, so no question is asked: docs/workbench/state.md is created with Project Lumen Notes and Checkpoints every-phase, AGENTS.md is created with the workbench section, and the reply reports both and names a next step.
assertions: docs/workbench/state.md is produced with the line `- Project: Lumen Notes` and the line `- Checkpoints: every-phase`
docs/workbench/state.md has the sections of the state contract: Autonomy, Artifacts (a table with the columns Artifact, Owner skill, Status, Updated), Decisions, Open questions and Approvals
AGENTS.md is produced and contains exactly one block between `<!-- workbench:start -->` and `<!-- workbench:end -->`, and that block states the mode `every-phase`
The reply does not ask for the name or the autonomy mode again and does not wait for an approval before writing
The files produced are only docs/workbench/state.md and AGENTS.md: no other file or folder under docs/ and no leftover scratch file
The reply reports the state file as created with autonomy every-phase and names a next step

evals.prompt: Onboard this repo to the workbench: name widgets, checkpoints at milestones. Register the specs we have at the root the way you'd map them. Keep our docs where they are.
evals.expected_output: ARCHITECTURE.md and DESIGN-SYSTEM.md registered in place as docs/engineering/architecture.md and docs/design/design-system.md; docs/button.md and CHANGELOG.md not registered; the existing AGENTS.md content preserved with the section appended; state created with Checkpoints milestones.
assertions: docs/workbench/state.md has an Artifacts row registering docs/engineering/architecture.md at ARCHITECTURE.md with owner `existing`
docs/workbench/state.md has an Artifacts row registering docs/design/design-system.md at DESIGN-SYSTEM.md with owner `existing`
docs/workbench/state.md has the line `- Project: widgets` and the line `- Checkpoints: milestones`
docs/button.md is not registered (no row for it in state.md) and the reply says why (end-user or product documentation)
CHANGELOG.md is not registered (no row for it in state.md) and is not among the files produced

AGENTS.md still starts with its original content, unchanged: the heading `# Widgets` and the line "Project conventions. Run `npm test` before pushing.", followed by exactly one block between `<!-- workbench:start -->` and `<!-- workbench:end -->`
The documents are registered in place: no file under docs/engineering/ or docs/design/ is produced, and nothing in the reply says a document was moved, renamed or copied

evals.prompt: Switch this project to milestones mode.
evals.expected_output: Detection shows the state exists with every-phase; the update path sets milestones in the state file and in the AGENTS.md section; the name and the registered rows stay; no question is asked.
assertions: The Checkpoints line in docs/workbench/state.md reads `- Checkpoints: milestones`

The project was updated, not initialized again: state.md still has `- Project: widgets` and both registered rows (docs/engineering/architecture.md at ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/design/design-system.md at DESIGN-SYSTEM.md), each exactly once

The workbench block in AGENTS.md states `milestones`, does not state `every-phase`, and appears exactly once; aGENTS.md still starts with its original content, unchanged: the heading `# Widgets` and the line "Project conventions. Run `npm test` before pushing."

The reply asks no question about the name or the registrations and reports the change as done: it says the autonomy mode is milestones after the update (a report line such as "state updated, autonomy milestones" counts; a plan or an offer to switch does not)
